title: Understanding Pruning
text: Pruning a decision tree involves removing branches that have little importance. This can help in simplifying the model.

title: Effect on Bias
text: Consider how removing branches might affect the model's ability to fit the training data. Does it make the model more or less flexible?

title: Bias and Flexibility
text: When a model is less flexible, it tends to have higher bias. Does pruning increase or decrease the model's flexibility?
